Name: (FS) Goldenfields Closet
Author: samsomn
Description:
[size=4][b]THIS IS MY FIRST MOD! If you experience any bugs or issues, please lmk![/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I made this mod for funsies for some alters in our system, Goldenfields, hence the name Goldenfields Closet! I hope you enjoy! If you have any suggestions, feel free to give em! <3[/color][/size]

Install this like any other fashion sense mod! ENJOY!!!!!!!!

The shoe mod in the showcase images: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24572]FS - SH's Boots and Shoes Pack at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]
The skirt mod in the showcase images:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10312]FS Kisekaes skirts at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]

Every other asset in the images is either made entirely by me or edited from Stardew Valley itself :)
